meta.notes: This list is not exhaustive per the City of Toronto. When in doubt, contact Toronto Building at toronto.ca/building or call 311. Zoning By-law compliance is always required regardless of permit status.

permit_required.description: Constructing any new building or structure.

permit_required.project_type: Home addition – second or third storey
permit_required.description: Adding a second or third floor to an existing building.
Constructing an attached garage or carport as an addition to an existing building.
Adding a sunroom or solarium as an addition to an existing building.
Constructing a deck or porch as an addition to an existing building. A permit is required if the deck is more than 60 cm (24 inches) above ground level.
conditions: Deck finished level is MORE than 60 cm (24 inches) above adjacent finished grade
OR the deck forms part of an exit required under the building code

permit_required.description: Making structural changes to an existing building including adding/removing walls, adding new windows or doors, enlarging or relocating existing windows or doors, or enclosing an existing deck/porch/patio of any size.
Constructing a shed with an area of 15 square metres (161 sq ft) or more.
conditions: Shed area is 15 m² (161 sq ft) or larger
OR shed is attached to an existing building (any size)
OR shed has plumbing (any size)

permit_required.description: Constructing a detached accessory structure larger than 10 square metres (107 sq ft), such as a detached garage, workshop, carport, pool house, or cabana. Also required if the structure is attached to an existing building or has plumbing, regardless of size.
conditions: Structure is larger than 10 m² (107 sq ft)
OR structure is attached to an existing building (any size)
OR structure has plumbing (any size)

permit_required.project_type: Basement finishing (with structural, plumbing, or HVAC work)
permit_required.description: Finishing a basement where the work includes structural or material alterations, installing or modifying heating or plumbing systems, excavating or constructing foundations, underpinning, constructing a basement entrance, or adding a second suite.
conditions: Work includes structural or material alterations
OR installing or modifying heating and/or plumbing systems
OR excavating and/or constructing foundations
OR basement underpinning
OR constructing a basement entrance
OR adding a second suite / legal basement apartment

permit_required.project_type: Green roof or rooftop stormwater system
permit_required.description: Installing a green roof or rooftop stormwater retention system.
Constructing a structure used in the support of a wind turbine generator with a rated output of more than 3 kW.
conditions: Rated output exceeds 3 kW

permit_required.project_type: Solar collector or solar hot water system
permit_required.description: Installing a solar collector system or solar hot water system.

permit_required.project_type: Retaining wall (on or near public property)
permit_required.description: Constructing a retaining wall more than 1 metre (3 ft 3 in) in height that is on or adjacent to public property (including streets), building entrances, or on private property accessible to the public.
conditions: Wall height exceeds 1 metre (3 ft 3 in)
AND wall is on/adjacent to public property, a building entrance, or private property accessible to the public

permit_required.description: Demolishing or removing all or a portion of a building.

permit_required.project_type: Chimney or fireplace installation or reconstruction
permit_required.description: Installing or reconstructing a chimney or fireplace, including a wood burning stove or fireplace.

permit_required.project_type: Heating or plumbing system installation or modification
permit_required.description: Installing or modifying heating (HVAC) and/or plumbing systems beyond simple fixture replacement.
Changing a building's use, such as from residential to commercial/office, or from a single dwelling unit to a multi-dwelling unit. A permit is required even if no construction is proposed.

permit_not_required.description: An uncovered platform (e.g. deck) that meets all exemption conditions.
conditions: Finished deck level is NOT more than 60 cm (24 inches) above adjacent finished grade
Does NOT form part of an exit required under the building code
Complies with the Zoning By-law
permit_not_required.notes: Zoning By-law compliance is still required even without a building permit.

permit_not_required.description: Installing a skylight in an existing house or small building.
conditions: Building is a house or small building 3 storeys or less
Installation does not require the removal of more than one rafter, joist, or similar structural member (trusses are not exempt)

permit_not_required.description: Re-cladding a house or small building with non-combustible material other than brick or stone veneer.
conditions: Building is 3 storeys or less
Material is non-combustible
Material is NOT brick or stone veneer (those require a permit)

permit_not_required.description: Adding or replacing insulation in an existing building.
Replacing existing windows or doors without changing their size or location.
conditions: No change in location or size of the window and/or door
The structural support (lintel) is not affected
A new exit is not created

permit_not_required.description: Replacing an existing furnace or boiler in a house.
conditions: Replacement only — not a new installation
In a house (not a large commercial or multi-unit building)

permit_not_required.project_type: Additional cooling, gas fireplace, or hot water tank (house)
permit_not_required.description: Installing additional cooling systems, gas fireplaces, air cleaners, in-line humidifiers, or hot water tanks in a house.
conditions: In a house
Work is an addition to existing systems, not a modification of the main system

permit_not_required.description: Repairing and replacing plumbing fixtures (e.g. toilet, faucet, sink).
conditions: Replacement only — no new drain lines or supply lines
Fixture remains in the same location

permit_not_required.description: Replacing existing roofing material where no structural work is required.
conditions: No structural work required
Replacing like-for-like roofing material

permit_not_required.project_type: Basic basement finishing (no structural, plumbing, or new suite)
permit_not_required.description: Finishing a basement in a house where no structural changes, new plumbing, or additional dwelling units are created.
conditions: No structural or material alterations
No additional dwelling unit(s) created
No new plumbing installed
permit_not_required.notes: As soon as any of the excluded conditions apply (structural changes, plumbing, or a new suite), a permit IS required. See PR-009.

permit_not_required.description: Undertaking waterproofing repairs to a basement.
Installing cabinetry and millwork (e.g. kitchen cabinets, built-in shelving).
conditions: No plumbing modifications involved

permit_not_required.description: Plastic sheet covered accessory structures such as snow canopies, driveway tents, and automotive canopies.
conditions: Installed on or after October 15th
Removed on or before April 15th
Complies with the Zoning By-law

permit_not_required.project_type: Retaining wall (private, not public-facing, under 1 m)
permit_not_required.description: Constructing a retaining wall entirely on private property that is not accessible to the public and is less than 1 metre in height.
conditions: On private property only
Not accessible to the public
Height is less than 1 metre at any location

permit_not_required.description: Constructing a small shed that meets all exemption conditions.
conditions: No more than 15 m² (161 sq ft) in gross area
No more than one storey in height
NOT attached to a building or any other structure
Used only for storage purposes ancillary to a principal building on the lot
Does NOT have plumbing

permit_not_required.description: Erecting a temporary tent or group of tents.
conditions: No more than 60 m² in aggregate ground area
Not attached to a building
Constructed more than 3 m from any other structure

always_required_notes: Zoning By-law compliance is required for ALL projects, even those that do not require a building permit.
This list is not exhaustive. When in doubt, contact Toronto Building via toronto.ca/building or call 311.
Even if a building permit is not required, other permits (e.g. electrical, heritage, sign) may still apply.
As the building owner, you are ultimately responsible for complying with all building requirements.
Failure to obtain required permits can result in costly construction delays, legal action, and/or the removal of completed work.
